newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent lower but narrows arbitrage with U.S..
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent lower but narrows arbitrage with U.S..

text.p: Brent October futures prices were traded lower on Tuesday compared with London's settlement on Friday, but narrowed the arbitrage against NYMEX.
October Brent last traded at $20.14 per barrel, down 27 cents from Brent's settlement on Friday in London.
Both SIMEX and London Brent markets were closed on Monday to mark a national holiday in the U.K.
NYMEX October crude last traded on the after-hours ACCESS system at $21.58, compared with a New York close on Monday of $21.62.
The Brent and NYMEX levels left the arbitrage at $1.43 compared with Friday's $1.55.
But brokers said SIMEX volume at 105 lots was light and could not be used as a major indication for how London might trade.
